reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because its primary purpose is explaining how to contact Facebook Ads Support about advertising, page, and pixel issues. The support form, instruction to chat with a representative, and separate like request are presented as ordinary support or channel-engagement actions, without a payment request, credential theft, victim loss, or deceptive transaction.

citations.quote: You can actually contact Facebook directly and talk to a real human about your ads, get the direct feedback of what's wrong with them, what you need to do better, or what's wrong with your page
So the first place you're gonna go is facebook.com slash business slash help
All you're gonna do is click chat with a representative like this and to bring you to this page right here.
So all it's gonna be is chat with our support team fill out your name fill out your address.
then right here. You're gonna click start chat

opening.argument: The support instructions are embedded in a broader acquisition funnel. Viewers are directed toward a free trial, a mentorship application, and the promoter's commercial sites while being shown a claimed $210,000-plus result. That links an easy-entry business opportunity and an attractive income claim to concrete viewer actions such as applying, starting a trial, or following external links. The support tutorial therefore functions as credibility-building around a money-making offer, rather than as a self-contained public-service explanation.

citations.quote: How I've made $210,000+ selling ONE random product I never see or touch
Get a FREE 2-week trial of Shopify to start dropshipping right now!!!
APPLY FOR MENTORSHIP HERE
https://www.SimplifiedDropshipping.com/

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense isolates the Facebook-support segment and omits the surrounding solicitation. The description does not merely offer a support URL: it pairs a large earnings claim with a free trial, a mentorship application, and a dropshipping site. Calling the support steps ordinary does not answer why they are presented alongside these commercial actions or why the income claim is used to attract viewers.

citations.quote: How I've made $210,000+ selling ONE random product I never see or touch
APPLY FOR MENTORSHIP HERE
Get a FREE 2-week trial of Shopify to start dropshipping right now!!!

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Those description links do not establish that viewers are promised cash for contacting support, nor that the support chat requires payment or enrollment. The claimed earnings statement describes the speaker's own experience, while the spoken instructions concern Facebook ads, pages, and pixels. The quoted material shows a business promotion surrounding the tutorial, but not a scam mechanism or a guaranteed viewer return.

citations.quote: get the direct feedback of what's wrong with them, what you need to do better, or what's wrong with your page
How I've made $210,000+ selling ONE random product I never see or touch

opening.argument: Several risk signals appear together: a prominent $210,000-plus success claim, a promise of location-neutral income automation, a free trial marketed to start immediately, numerous external links, and endorsements invoked as authority. The combination lowers the apparent barrier to entry while emphasizing exceptional returns and urgency. Even though the video demonstrates a support workflow, that workflow can make the surrounding dropshipping pitch look operationally validated without establishing that ordinary viewers can reproduce the advertised result.

citations.quote: How I've made $210,000+ selling ONE random product I never see or touch
I used to be a busser and an uber driver, but now I have obtained location neutral income automation and helping others too!
Get a FREE 2-week trial of Shopify to start dropshipping right now!!!
I'm also known for my endorsements from figures such as Tai Lopez, Oberlo, and Shopify

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense's account leaves out the unusually strong promotional signals surrounding the tutorial. A claimed six-figure result, “income automation,” immediate free-trial language, and named endorsements are not explained merely by saying the speaker shows a support page. The support content can be genuine while still serving as persuasive evidence for a risky income proposition.

citations.quote: How I've made $210,000+ selling ONE random product I never see or touch
location neutral income automation
Get a FREE 2-week trial of Shopify to start dropshipping right now!!!

true_side_reply.rebuttal: These are promotional risk indicators, but they do not prove the specific low-barrier reward mechanism required here. No quoted material promises the viewer a fixed payment, withdrawal, or guaranteed return for taking an action. A free trial and external links may advertise a business service; they do not by themselves show deception, victim loss, or that the speaker's result is promised to viewers.

citations.quote: Get a FREE 2-week trial of Shopify to start dropshipping right now!!!
How I've made $210,000+ selling ONE random product I never see or touch

opening.argument: Although the visible lesson is framed as Facebook support education, the surrounding material makes the practical role promotional. The speaker presents himself as someone who teaches dropshipping and digital marketing, directs viewers to a specialized dropshipping site, asks them to apply for mentorship, and uses his personal success story as credibility. The support walkthrough can therefore operate as a trust-building demonstration that steers viewers toward a commercial income program, rather than remaining neutral technical education.

citations.quote: Hey all! My name is Scott Hilse, I am here to teach you dropshipping, or should I say, Simplified Dropshipping!
I am here to teach you dropshipping, or should I say, Simplified Dropshipping!
APPLY FOR MENTORSHIP HERE
I worked with a representative who helped me fine-tune everything.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense describes the immediate topic but not the video's commercial role. The speaker explicitly says he teaches dropshipping and digital marketing, while the description solicits mentorship and promotes a dropshipping business. His account of obtaining special help from a representative gives the broader offer an aura of insider access, which is promotional even if the Facebook page itself is real.

citations.quote: I am here to teach you dropshipping, or should I say, Simplified Dropshipping!
APPLY FOR MENTORSHIP HERE
I worked with a representative who helped me fine-tune everything.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The speaker's broader business identity and mentorship link establish promotion, but not that the support tutorial is a deceptive cash-acquisition scheme. The support explanation tells viewers where to seek help with ads and pages, and the personal anecdote describes assistance with an ad. Promotional context alone cannot convert ordinary instruction into proof of a promised reward or fraudulent transaction.
